sample_unit: guideline decision points (PICO prompts) per model

links.outcome: Concordance of LLM answers with AAOS knee osteoarthritis guidelines across 33 decision points
links.effect: Full concordance in 84.8% of ChatGPT and 75.8% of NotebookLM responses; mean composite 3.67 vs 3.55 (p=0.18); discordant responses involved overstated or speculative interpretations.
links.quote: Full concordance with AAOS recommendations occurred in 84.8% of ChatGPT responses and 75.8% of NotebookLM responses.

unlisted_practices: Structured, guideline-oriented PICO prompting to improve LLM reasoning consistency

screen.reason: The study evaluates the concordance of two LLMs (ChatGPT and NotebookLM) with clinical practice guidelines (AAOS knee osteoarthritis) using expert physician ratings. It does not evaluate a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
